Step P

Your setup block

  1. Tap Copy setup block below.
  2. Open a new chat in Claude and paste it in. Press send.
  3. Wait for Claude to reply “Command codes ready.”
Command Codes setup block

    

    
Make them permanent: paste the setup block into a Claude Project’s instructions. Every chat in that Project will know your codes, with no pasting needed.

Your 4 starter codes

Stay safe

    
A few rules that protect you

    

      
Never share
  • Social Security numbers
  • Bank or card numbers
  • Passwords or PINs
  • Private medical details

      
Always
  • Double-check facts and numbers
  • Verify Bible verses
  • Ask a real expert for big decisions
  • Hang up on “urgent” money calls

    

    
AI is a tool. Ask the Lord Jesus for wisdom. These codes support your walk; they don’t replace the voice of God, your leader, a counselor, or a doctor.
